items.label: Verified identity, per signer
items.details: Charged to the organization for each member holding a verified identity, beyond the ones included in its plan. It lets its holder sign with an advanced e-signature.

items.label: Advanced e-signatures
items.details: Advanced digital signatures with qualified certificates for signing legally binding actions that require high proof security.

items.label: Additional certified storage
items.details: Certified encrypted storage above 1GB is charged monthly for both organizations and personal workspaces. Data is timestamped, versioned and encrypted with keys held by workspace members. Encrypted copies are replicated on a public decentralized storage network (IPFS): only workspace members can decrypt or modify them.

items.label: Sponsored transactions
items.details: Recording an operation on the network has a technical cost: Organigram covers it for your signers and bills only the actual cost, including processing fees, converted to euros every minute, with a minimum of 0.01€.

items.label: Workspace Agent (per 1M tokens)
items.details: Workspace assistance and assisted organigram generation include 5 successful requests before these rates apply.
